title: Reported Speech: Pronouns and Possessives — Quiz 127
content:
## Reported Speech: Pronouns and Possessives

Choose pronouns and possessive adjectives to match the speaker and listener.

### Lesson focus

1. The teacher said, “Raj, you are one of my best students.”
2. My friends and I said, “We should plant trees.”
3. Our new teacher said, “Dear children, you are the author of your own destinies.”

### Understand the pattern

Possessive adjectives must follow the same viewpoint as personal pronouns. My, your and our identify whose object or quality is being discussed. If the listener is not explicitly the reporter, do not automatically turn you into I or we.

### Worked answers and explanation

1. The teacher told Raj that he was one of the teacher's best students.
2. My friends and I said that we should plant trees.
3. The new teacher told the children that they were the authors of their own destinies.

Repeating the teacher's name or role can avoid an ambiguous his or her.

### Try another

Report: Asha said to me, 'This is your bag, not mine.'

### Suggested answer

Asha told me that it was my bag, not hers. The possessives change because the reporting viewpoint has changed.
